Jwt._comment: SECURITY: Secret below is a DEV-ONLY placeholder. Before deploying, move this to an environment variable or a secrets manager (e.g. `dotnet user-secrets` locally, Azure Key Vault / AWS Secrets Manager in production) and DELETE the value from this file. Never commit a real secret to source control.

Cors._comment: Wildcard is fine for local dev only. Replace with real app/web origins before production (see release checklist: 'CORS policy — restrict to actual app domains, not wildcard').

ExternalServices._comment: Placeholders for Phase 5+/G1-G5 integrations. Fill in via environment variables or user-secrets, not directly here.

Push._comment: FCM HTTP v1 API needs a full service-account JSON (Firebase Console > Project Settings > Service Accounts > Generate new private key), not the legacy server key.

RateLimiting._comment: Off by default in dev. Set EnableRateLimiting=true in production config/env vars.

Redis._comment: Off by default in dev (falls back to in-memory cache). Set Enabled=true + a real ConnectionString in production.
